svg.text: S T R E E T
LEVEL +0.00 · SCALE 1:75 @ A1 · ALL DIMENSIONS IN METRES
Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm partition, 300 mm external / party
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab over)
1. Site boundaries and the 23.00 × 5.00 m garden corridor are taken from the
client's survey sketch. All boundary dimensions to be confirmed by
measured survey before any work starts on site.
2. Blocks A and B sit hard against the north, east and west boundaries. The
south elevation onto the garden is the only open facade, so a 2.65 × 2.48
m light court is cut through all three storeys to daylight the centre of
3. The garden falls 0.45 m from the house threshold to the gate. Surface
water to a soakaway within the planted border.
4. No part of the new work oversails or undermines the adjoining plots; party
wall notices to be served on the north, east and west owners before
Preliminary design issue — not for construction. Do not scale from this drawing;
work to figured dimensions only and verify all levels and site boundaries before work.
